svg.text: Each residue is helical (h) or coil (c); a helix pays σs for its first residue and s for each later one
weight = (σs)·s⁴ · (σs)·s² = σ² s⁸: two helices, eight helical residues
Left: smaller σ, sharper transition (slope 1/(4√σ) at s = 1).
Right: short chains cannot pay the nucleation cost and need s well above 1.
